long_biography.plain_text:
Klüh grew up around the cleaning business his grandfather established and his mother and grandmother revived after his father's wartime death. In 1962, they transferred the operation to him at twenty. Beginning with two employees, he built a leading regional contractor through direct customer acquisition, disciplined growth and an early understanding of corporate outsourcing.

Diversification brought clinic services, security, catering and airport operations, followed by an international push at the turn of the century. The group developed into a multi-service provider for business, healthcare, aviation and public-sector clients across several countries. Klüh withdrew from day-to-day management but remained sole owner and advisory-board chair, preserving strategic influence while professional executives run the holding company.
